title: 50 Cent Shares a Popsicle PSA After Outshine Recall: ‘Can’t Eat Lettuce, Can’t Eat Popsicles’
summary: Outshine's parent company Dreyer's issued a voluntary recall on five flavors because they might be contaminated with glass.
body: 50 Cent is just like the rest of us. The rapper and film producer took to Instagram to post a video of him throwing out boxes of what looks like grape and strawberry Outshine popsicles after parent company Dreyer’s Grand Ice Cream issued a voluntary recall earlier this week. He also attached a meme of the current United States Secretary of Health and Human Services Robert F. Kennedy Jr. smiling with a list of the flavors that were recalled by the company.
